surfaces.part: leaf canopy (organic mass, dome-shaped with highlight on upper left)

answer.evidence: The tree is a dense round canopy (rows 1-53) with a short trunk and roots (rows 54-63). Its width profile grows steadily to a maximum of about 47 at rows 36-37 and then narrows, so it is one blob and not a top band over a face. The trunk is a narrow vertical strip with no top surface. The result is an organic silhouette seen face-on, so it reads as a front elevation.
